title: DesignProposal
tagline: A new easy way for DAOs to design proposals by vote before submitting for DAO wide acceptance
description: This project is about helping DAOs get their proposals right with community involvement. The challenge today is that drawing up a DAO proposal requires a lot of expertise in one individual with a successful proposal having wide ranging and usually long term impacts on the DAO community. Thus the community needs to be involved. De Prop seeks to reduce the hurdles associated with proposal participation by allowing DAO members to vote on elements of proposals whilst their still in their design stage and prior to a wider community vote on proposal submission The idea is that interested users would be given bite size chunks of the proposal on which to vote and publicly comment.
how_its_made: The project is built using EVM technology and IPFS / Filecoin as the primary drivers, with the goal being to totally decentralize the service and make it easy for DAOs to use in a permission less manner.  The service also uses NFTPort to provide NFT based proofs back to contributors when they add new sections to the proposals.
